bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; making certain technical clarifying changes; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.011, subdivisions 1, 7, 68.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.011, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Terms.
For the purposes of this chapter, the terms defined in this section have the meanings given.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.011, subdivision 7, is amended to read:

Subd. 7.
Bicycle route.
"Bicycle route" means a roadway or shoulder signed to encourage bicycle use.

Sec. 3.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.011, subdivision 68, is amended to read:

Subd. 68.
Roadway.
"Roadway" means that portion of a highway improved, designed, or ordinarily used for vehicular travel, exclusive of the sidewalk or shoulder. During periods when the commissioner allows the use of dynamic shoulder lanes as defined in subdivision 25, roadway includes that shoulder. In the event a highway includes two or more separate roadways, roadway refers to each roadway separately but not to all the roadways collectively.
